messages:
sophia: Heads-up 1: planning the artifact escrow + access handshake for the new hardware SI listing. Need rules for transfer, temporary creds, and chain-of-custody. Can we do a quick 20m Wed 10:30 PT?

noah: Wed 10:30 works. Proposal: no presigned URLs in email, use cross-account STS AssumeRole with session tags and a 12h session TTL. Log every AssumeRole in the custody ledger.

emma: +1 to STS. For HSM-related artifacts we also need a certificate fingerprint and KMS-wrapped envelope. Hardware partner asked for a pointer to the infra diagram  but we must redact internal IPs.

own: I'll take ownership of redaction policy for diagrams and topology docs. Suggestion: redaction layers: (1) PII, (2) internal hostnames/IPs, (3) non-essential telemetry endpoints.

security-bot: Reminder: pen test results must include CWE mappings, severity, and remediation owner. Also include tool-version metadata (nmap/nessus/oss-fuzz) in the bundle.

sophia: Good catch. Also need attestation template from SI: they must confirm limited use, key rotation cadence, and destroy copies after verification. Add to handshake agenda.

noah: Manifest format idea (ledger-friendly JSONL) so we can append custody events. Example entry:```
{
  "bundle_id":"2026-03-12T15:00:00Z",
  "file":"soc2_v3.pdf",
  "sha256":"<hex>",
  "cert_sha1":"<fingerprint>",
  "sensitivity":"restricted",
  "redaction_version":"r2",
  "upload_step":"redacted-upload",
  "owner":"noah@redwood.com"
}
```
This allows appending custody lines like:```
{
  "event":"assume-role",
  "actor":"partner-daren@si.com",
  "ts":"2026-03-13T09:02:12Z",
  "session_id":"s3sess-abc123",
  "policy":"read-only,download=1"
}
```

emma: I like JSONL. Can we include a signed manifest root hash and push that index to an immutable object store (S3 with Object Lock)? That way partners can verify integrity without holding files.

own: yes, publish root manifest.jsonl.sha256 sig to s3://marketplace-index/immutable/ with object lock and small TTL for public index copies.

sophia: Legal asked for retention language: we must keep originals for 180 days by default, but allow an extension request to 540 days with justification. Also auto-archive to cold storage after 30 days for restricted items.

security-bot: Policy note: for pen-tests, redact contact info for testers, but keep vulnerability IDs and remediation notes. Use redaction rule set v3. Add metatags: tool, version, cve-list.

noah: Action items I captured: 1) owen author redaction rules and sample redacted diagram by Tue EOD (TKT-6789); 2) sophia to get SI attestation template and NDA confirmation; 3) emma to provision KMS key + cross-account role and post ARN to ticket; 4) Ill produce sample JSONL manifest + root hash and push to index.

sophia: I'll schedule the 20m handshake with Daren and cc legal. Please include the sample manifest and a short README describing the custody flow.

own: Quick question 1: for emergency escalations can we allow a 1h emergency access token? that should be logged and require two approvers.

emma: Approved in principle. Two-approver flow needs automation. I'll stub an automation runbook in the ticket (TKT-6790).

sophia: Great. Post the manifest and runbook in TKT-6789 and we'll close after the handshake. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
